floater.name: ocol_mist
floater.title: OCOL MIST

check_box.label: Volumetric fog
check_box.name: fog_on
check_box.tool_tip: The volumetric fog the mist is a mode of (Preferences > Graphics > Lighting).

check_box.label: OCOL rolling mist
check_box.name: ocol_on
check_box.tool_tip: The OCOL viewer's rolling ground mist: its own layer, broken into drifting banks and wisps. Off = the fog follows the region's sky.

slider.label: Density
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogDensity
slider.tool_tip: Mist density at the base of the layer, per metre: higher = shorter visibility.

slider.label: Base above water
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogBaseHeight
slider.tool_tip: Height of the dense part of the layer above the water (m).

slider.label: Height
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogFalloff
slider.tool_tip: How quickly the mist thins above its base (m): larger = taller mist.

slider.label: Breakup
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogBreakup
slider.tool_tip: How much the mist breaks into banks and gaps: 0 = an even layer.

slider.label: Bank size
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogBankSize
slider.tool_tip: Size of the mist banks (m); the wisps are a third of it.

slider.label: Roll height
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogRollHeight
slider.tool_tip: How far the top of the layer rises and falls with the banks (m).

slider.label: Drift speed
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogWindSpeed
slider.tool_tip: How fast the mist drifts (m/s). Everyone sees the same drift.

slider.label: Drift heading
slider.name: OCOLHeightFogWindDirection
slider.tool_tip: Compass heading the mist drifts toward (0 north, 90 east).

slider.label: Ambient
slider.name: RenderVKVolumetricFogAmbient
slider.tool_tip: How much the sky lights the mist.

slider.label: Sun shafts
slider.name: RenderVKVolumetricFogSunScatter
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the sun / moon shafts through the haze.

slider.label: Lamp glow
slider.name: RenderVKVolumetricFogLocalLights
slider.tool_tip: How much point lights and projectors light the mist.

slider.label: Range
slider.name: RenderVKVolumetricFogRange
slider.tool_tip: How far the volumetric mist reaches (m); past it the layer continues smooth, without banks.

slider.label: Smoothing
slider.name: RenderVKVolumetricFogHistory
slider.tool_tip: Frame-to-frame smoothing of the fog grid: higher = calmer but slower to follow; 0 = off (noisier).

floater.text: The layer and banks apply with OCOL rolling mist on; light and range apply to all volumetric fog.
